description:
Requirements:

  • Bachelor degree in Economics or Engineering;
  • Experience in the procurement/purchasing area, at least 3 years;
  • Cost and quality purchasing activity;
  • Product and market knowledge, Lean Basics, Cost savings and Supplier relationship;
  • Proficiency in English, German is a plus;
  • SAP operation and knowledge of primary accounting;
  • Technical knowledge and market knowledge (suppliers, prices);
  • Management of the relationship with suppliers;
  • Data analysis and techniques of negotiation;
  • Effective oral and written communication skills;
  • Proven ability to manage multiple assignments, priorities, and projects in a demanding environment;
  • Ability to apply critical thinking skills when making decisions or solving problems; 
  • Ability to collaborate and work within a team environment.

Main responsibilities:

  • Makes market analysis and offers comparison;
  • Negotiates with suppliers;
  • Collaborates with the HQ in Germany;
  • Sets up a number of potentials supplier/commodity;
  • Maintains and develops important customer-supplier relationship;
  • Processes complaints from escalation level;
  • Is responsible to achieve the savings targets and responsible for the continuous improvement programs in the context of purchasing goals;
  • Supports and participates in projects;
  • Finds, evaluates and suggests reliable commodity suppliers;
  • Handles and manages presentations for meetings.


JOYSONQUIN Automotive Systems Romania produces steering wheels and ornamental elements for the dashboard, doors and center console, based on a modern technology and the diversity of materials used: noble veneer, leather, carbon and plastic. For over 15 years we have been satisfying the needs of our clients, renowned car manufacturers, such as Mercedes, Bentley, Audi, BMW, Porsche and Volkswagen.
The quality of the products and the trust that our customers give us are the result of the professionalism of our employees. The company has 1000 employees in Ghimbav and is constantly developing.
